service_adjacency.reason: A handed-over BMU needs scheduled preventive maintenance after the defects-liability period; the installer is the natural AMC holder.
BMUs and their cradles require periodic thorough examination, load tests and third-party certificates.
Façade-access tenders combine the BMU with monorails, davits and anchors for zones the BMU cannot reach.
Old BMUs are modernised by replacing cradles, hoists and wire ropes rather than the whole machine.
A monorail/davit enquiry often sits in the same Division 11 package as a BMU.
Anchors, lifelines and davits need periodic recertification (EN 795 / BS 7883 / IWCA I-14.1).
Monorail hoists and trolleys need the same preventive maintenance cycle as BMUs.
Rental cradles generate installation, shifting between drops, wire-rope and spare-part work.
Sites ask for a load test / third-party inspection before a suspended platform is used.
Façade contractors renting cradles usually also need boom or spider lifts for low-level and podium work.
High-rise main contractors procure hoists and tower cranes for the same construction phase.
Long-term hoist rentals and owned hoists need monthly maintenance and statutory inspections.
Tower-crane projects soon need a construction hoist for people and materials.
Cranes require third-party load tests and periodic examination certificates.
Crane rentals are often bare or with operator; offer certified operators and riggers.
Industrial and oil & gas sites ask for certified operators (TPI-carded) with the machine.
Clients require a valid third-party inspection certificate for every machine delivered.
Fleet owners and long-term renters need tyres, batteries and repairs.
Scaffold sale or rental is usually paired with erection, modification and dismantling labour.
Scaffolds need inspection and tagging before use and after changes.
High façades switch from scaffolding to suspended platforms above a certain height.
Glazed space-frame roofs and skylights need cleaning access (gantries, travelling ladders, anchors) — often missing from the steel package.
Space-frame bidders are often asked for related steel works, canopies and shades.
Cleaning contractors operating a building's BMU/cradles need the machines maintained and inspected.
AMC visits surface defects that become repair and spare-part quotations, especially under labour-only contracts.
Annual third-party inspection is a natural add-on to an AMC.
A repaired machine without a maintenance contract is an AMC lead.
Failed inspections create repair and replacement-part work.
Every supplied-and-installed system can be followed by a maintenance contract after warranty.
Commissioning requires load tests and third-party certification before handover.
